items.exampleEn: He wears a dark suit to work.
Her appearance is very important to her.
items.exampleZh: 外表對她來說非常重要。

items.exampleEn: The beauty of this place surprised me.
items.exampleZh: 這個地方的美讓我很驚訝。

items.exampleEn: She works in the fashion business.
These pants are too big. I need a belt.
items.exampleZh: 這條褲子太大了，我需要一條皮帶。

items.exampleEn: Students at this school wear a uniform.
items.exampleZh: 這所學校的學生要穿制服。

items.exampleEn: You look slim in that dress.
items.exampleZh: 你穿那件洋裝看起來很苗條。

items.sentenceEn: That blue dress really suits you.
items.sentenceZh: 那件藍色洋裝真適合你。

items.audioEn: In my office, we don't wear uniforms, but we can't wear jeans.
items.audioZh: 在我們公司不用穿制服，但不能穿牛仔褲。
items.questionZh: 說話的人上班時不能穿什麼？

items.sentenceEn: Don't judge people by their appearance.
He bought a new suit for the wedding.
items.sentenceZh: 他為了婚禮買了一套新西裝。

items.stemEn: My pants keep falling down. I need a ____.
items.stemZh: 我的褲子一直往下掉，我需要一條皮帶。

items.passageEn: Lisa works for a fashion magazine. At first, she always wore a dark suit and a black belt to work, like a uniform. One day her boss said, "This is a fashion magazine! Try some colors!" Now Lisa enjoys bright clothes. She also learned something important: beauty is not only about appearance. Being kind is beautiful, too.
items.passageZh: Lisa 在一家時尚雜誌社工作。一開始，她上班總是穿深色套裝、繫黑色皮帶，像穿制服一樣。有一天，她的老闆說：「這可是時尚雜誌！試試看穿點顏色吧！」現在 Lisa 很喜歡穿鮮豔的衣服。她也學到一件重要的事：美不只是外表，善良也是一種美。

questions.questionZh: Lisa 一開始上班都穿什麼？

referenceEn: My sister is tall and slim.
My older sister is tall and slim.
rubricZh: 「又高又苗條」可寫例如 tall and slim、tall and thin
be 動詞配合主詞（例如 My sister is）

referenceEn: My new uniform is too big.
My new uniform is too large.
rubricZh: 「太大」可寫，例如 too big、too large 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關：正解是唯一動詞、只靠詞性可選；改四選項同詞性
執行長第②③關裁示修正：選項釋義同步
第②關：釋義「西裝；適合（動詞）」含兩個詞義，但例句 "He wears a dark suit to work." 只示範名詞「西裝」；依撰寫準則 §3 釋義要對得上例句用法，建議 glossZh 只寫「西裝；套裝」（動詞 suit 已在聽打與 mcq 練到）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 不改：本課聽打（That blue dress really suits you.）與 mcq 用 suit 動詞「適合」，依執行長「釋義要涵蓋本課題目用到的詞義，必要時兩義並列」保留兩義

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 FIX：care about（動詞「在意」B1）非目標字詞義越級
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "Her appearance is very important to her."（原 "She cares a lot about her appearance."）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：中譯同步
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "外表對她來說非常重要。"（原 "她非常在意自己的外表。"）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長裁示：正解長度均衡：干擾項補細節，意思仍與短文不符
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "鮮豔的洋裝和高跟鞋"（原 "鮮豔的洋裝"）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長裁示：後期規則補正：單字卡釋義拿掉詞性標記，統一「X；Y」格式、例句詞義在前
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "西裝；適合"（原 "西裝；適合（動詞）"）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 創辦人裁示：造句改翻譯：造句題（uniform）原位換成翻譯題，沿用題 id a2-u07-l02-q16；目標字沿用 uniform
